_readme: the Duchess's call on each plan the game files give no source for. Key = plan BOOK FormID. status: bugged (real bug, stays tradeable, on the Bugged section) | unreleased (never released: cut, not tradeable, on the Unreleased / leftover content section) | legacy (used to drop, old copies trade: stays on the site, plan check and mule lists, never cut) | leave (looked at, no change). Written by Brewmaster from Mia's To finish answers (miaLink plan_status) and read by src/plan_learn_routes.py and src/build_bugged_plans_json.py. Live only.
